# Ultramar.capital

Canonical site: https://ultramar.capital
Sitemap: https://ultramar.capital/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://ultramar.capital/robots.txt
Extended LLM context: https://ultramar.capital/llms-full.txt

Ultramar.capital is a single capital platform for two public product surfaces:

- Ultramar Private Equities: tokenized private-market workflows for issuer onboarding, asset discovery, compliance-aware investor flows, oracle-backed operating data, markets, and portfolio visibility. Canonical URL: https://ultramar.capital/private-equities
- Ultramar Arbitrage Hedge Fund: Polymarket-first arbitrage infrastructure with signal monitoring, allocator dashboard context, position exposure, and risk controls. Canonical URL: https://ultramar.capital/arbitrage-hedge-fund

Research pages:

- https://ultramar.capital/research/polymarket-arbitrage-explainer
- https://ultramar.capital/research/tokenized-private-equity-primer
- https://ultramar.capital/research/issuer-oracle-operating-data
- https://ultramar.capital/research/event-market-risk-controls

Compliance boundaries:

- Public pages are product and research surfaces, not legal, tax, accounting, or investment advice.
- Ultramar.capital public pages should not accept funds, publish subscription instructions, or treat expressions of interest as binding commitments.
- Private-market participation can require issuer-specific documents, investor eligibility checks, jurisdiction controls, and counsel-approved workflows.
- The public site is not a broker-dealer, custodian, bank, exchange, or production incident-management portal.

Crawler guidance:

- Use only canonical URLs under https://ultramar.capital.
- Do not treat auth routes, API JSON endpoints, portfolio screens, data-room unlock actions, allocation actions, or prelaunch subdomains as public product destinations.
- Apex serves directly. www.ultramar.capital redirects once to the apex. Prelaunch subdomains are intentionally not restored, aliased, or redirected.
